worldcombat.skill.belch.summary: The user crunches and swallows the Berry it holds, then lets out the pressure in one short, wide cloud of toxic gas that drenches everything in front: foes caught in it are hurt and likely poisoned. With no Berry in hand the move cannot be used at all. Acrid poisons more and longer, at a little less power and a slower cast and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.belch.use.0: Trade the held Berry for one heavy frontal spray
worldcombat.skill.belch.use.1: Poison a whole line of foes in one breath
worldcombat.skill.belch.use.2: Shroud a small squad at short range
worldcombat.skill.belch.use.3: Spend a Berry for a solid chunk of Poison damage
worldcombat.skill.belch.description.0: The gas is Poison-type special damage: every foe caught takes one hit of about %1$s damage, lighter the farther it is from the user. The foe's Special Defence, type matchups and critical hits are settled on impact.
worldcombat.skill.belch.description.1: The gas reaches %1$s blocks in front and spans %2$s degrees; a foe caught has a %3$s%% chance to be poisoned for about %4$s seconds, taking damage over time while poisoned.
worldcombat.skill.belch.acrid.on: Acrid on: poison chance +0.18 and poison duration ×1.4, at ×0.88 power and a slower cast and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.belch.acrid.off: Acrid off (Sharp): ×1.15 power and a faster cast, with a lower poison chance.
worldcombat.skill.belch.timing: Cast at a target within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s-second prepare it consumes one held Berry and %4$s PP, then recovers %3$s seconds; cooldown %5$s seconds. Unusable while no Berry is held.
worldcombat.skill.belch.growth.0: At level %1$s, gas power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.belch.preference.acrid: On: poison chance +0.18 and poison duration ×1.4, at ×0.88 power and a slower cast and cooldown, to poison a whole line. Off (Sharp): ×1.15 power with a lower poison chance, to land one heavy blow.
worldcombat.skill.belch.preference.ai.ma: Only belches at targets within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
worldcombat.skill.belch.preference.ai.cl: On: ranks the belch higher when the fan in front can cover two or more foes (it may leave its spot to line up). Off: treats it as an ordinary spell.
worldcombat.skill.belch.description.targ: One cloud catches at most %1$s foes, and each target is struck only once.
